lines.text: Because the famine was severe, Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while.
Pharaoh treated Abram well and he acquired animals and servants, but the LORD sent Pharaoh a warning dream.

wrong_details.wrong: the LORD sent Pharaoh a warning dream
wrong_details.true: the LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues

lines.text: Pharaoh summoned Abram, asked why he had not said Sarai was his wife, and had his men throw him in prison.

wrong_details.wrong: had his men throw him in prison
